main_text.p: in Hispalensi[?], Ad Hebræos Epistolæ risque Latinis ejus esse incerta est, propter dissonantiam sermonis.

XLIX. Hincmarus Archiepiscopus Rhemensis, primùm Monachus S. Dionysij, medio nono sæculo illustris, in Gottescalcum iniquissimus: Opusculo LV.[?] ad Hincmarum Laudunensem Episcopum, sancta quippe Ecclesia, quam beatus Paulus Apostolus, manentem civitatem & ædificationem &c. Sic alibi sæpius eandem Paulo adscribit Epistolam.

L. Remigius Lugdunensis Ecclesiæ Episcopus, prioribus σύγχρονος[?], favens causæ Gottescalci; Commentatus est in hanc Epistolam, ut & reliquas Paulinas, suntque illi ipsi Commentarij Remigio Rhemensi, duobus sæculis vetustiori, perperam adscripti à Bapt. Vilalpando. Hic cum Haymone, reliquisque Commentatoribus, de authore Paulo scribit, & sentit.
LI. Lupus Servatus, Presbyter, itidem coævus, doctrinæ etiam Augustinianæ de particulari gratiâ doctissimus vindex,

page.notes: Line 1 of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page; the first words are heavily smudged and uncertain ("Hispalensi" and "Epistolæ" are best readings). "risque" is the end of a word split from the previous line ("Epistolæ"). The Greek word after "prioribus" is uncertain (read as σύγχρονος, possibly another word). "LV." may be printed as "Lv.". The running head is the printed title "De Authore Epistola". Italic type is used for the names of authors and titles; the page appears otherwise in roman type. No margin notes are present.
